name: Oohira Yuuki
source:
Konno's best friend since he was a student.
A rich guy who is not very good at socializing.
He is a bit of a weirdo who has a somewhat different way of thinking, but he gets along with Konno.
He only focuses on the things he finds important, which is both an advantage and a disadvantage.
